snippet.title: Retrace the Light | Latest Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Hi everyone, We're excited to announce that Retrace the Light officially launches in November, and this Trailer will show our latest work on Gameplay, hope you like it!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179370/Retrace_The_Light/ 

About the game: Retrace the Light is a captivating 2.5D action-adventure game centered around “Spatial Retracing ” feature.
